app.//: The bridge returns every execute_js result through window.__TAURI__.core.invoke, which only exists with withGlobalTauri. Without it the plugin logs '__TAURI__ not available' and every webview_* tool times out after 2s. Dev-only, exactly like the capability below.

capabilities.description: Dev-only agent bridge. Inlined here rather than dropped in capabilities/, which the build script scans whole — a file in there would demand the plugin from every release build too.
